name: ifms_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for iFMS fertilizer subsidy authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid or mobile not registered.

name: ifms_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT check eligibility or record purchases. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: ifms_check_eligibility
description: Checks farmer's eligibility for fertilizer subsidy based on Aadhaar-linked records, land size, crop type, and season. Subsidy is purchase-linked — it reduces the price at point of sale, NOT a direct cash transfer. Returns eligibility_status ('eligible', 'not_eligible') with quantity limits. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate purchase. Fails if farmer has no land records, crop-fertilizer mismatch, or quantity limits already exhausted for the season.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: ifms_get_fertilizer_availability
description: Checks fertilizer stock availability at retailers in a location. Returns inventory_status ('available', 'low_stock', 'out_of_stock') per fertilizer type. PUBLIC-facing but requires session_token for farmer-specific recommendations. Does NOT reserve stock. Availability is dynamic and may change. Fails if location invalid or no retailers found.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: ifms_get_retailer_list
description: Returns list of authorized fertilizer retailers/dealers in a location. Only purchases from authorized retailers qualify for subsidy. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate purchases. Fails if no authorized retailers found in the area.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: ifms_initiate_purchase
description: Initiates a fertilizer purchase transaction at an authorized retailer. Transitions transaction_status to 'initiated'. Farmer must be authenticated via Aadhaar at point of sale. Requires session_token. Does NOT complete purchase or apply subsidy. Fails if retailer not authorized, farmer not eligible, Aadhaar authentication invalid at POS, or quantity exceeds season limits.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

retailer_id.description: Unique identifier of the authorized fertilizer retailer.

name: ifms_validate_transaction
description: Validates a purchase transaction by verifying Aadhaar biometric/OTP at the point of sale. Transitions transaction_status to 'validated'. Transaction must be 'initiated'. Requires session_token. Does NOT complete the purchase. Fails if transaction not initiated, Aadhaar mismatch, duplicate validation attempt, or POS terminal error.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier of the fertilizer purchase transaction.

name: ifms_complete_purchase
description: Completes the fertilizer purchase transaction. Transitions transaction_status to 'completed' and purchase_status to 'recorded'. Transaction must be 'validated'. Subsidy is automatically applied at point of sale (price reduced upfront). Requires session_token. Does NOT track subsidy settlement to company. Fails if transaction not validated, POS failure, or duplicate completion.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: ifms_apply_subsidy
description: Records the subsidy application against a completed purchase. Transitions subsidy_status to 'applied'. Subsidy is provided to fertilizer companies (not farmers directly) — the farmer benefit is the reduced price. Purchase must be 'completed'. Requires session_token. Does NOT settle subsidy with company. Fails if purchase not completed, subsidy already applied, or quantity-subsidy mismatch.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: ifms_track_transaction
description: Tracks the current transaction_status ('initiated', 'validated', 'completed', 'failed') and subsidy_status ('not_applied', 'applied', 'verified', 'settled'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify transaction. Fails if transaction_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: ifms_get_purchase_history
description: Retrieves all past fertilizer purchase records for the farmer including fertilizer types, quantities, dates, retailers, and subsidy amounts. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate new purchases. Fails if no records exist.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: ifms_check_inventory_status
description: Checks real-time inventory status at a specific retailer for a fertilizer type. Returns inventory_status ('available', 'low_stock', 'out_of_stock') with quantity details. Requires session_token. Inventory data may be stale. Does NOT reserve stock. Fails if retailer_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: ifms_resolve_transaction_ambiguity
description: Resolves ambiguous or conflicting transaction records when duplicate or partial transactions are detected. Returns disambiguation details. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify transactions. Fails if no ambiguity detected.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: ifms_cancel_transaction
description: Cancels a fertilizer purchase transaction. Only possible when transaction_status is 'initiated' (before validation). Transitions to 'failed'. Requires session_token. Does NOT reverse completed purchases. Fails if transaction already validated, completed, or subsidy applied.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: ifms_calculate_subsidy
description: Calculates the subsidy amount for a given fertilizer type and quantity. Returns subsidized price, full price, and savings. Requires session_token. Calculation is informational only — actual subsidy is applied at POS. Does NOT apply subsidy. Fails if fertilizer type unsupported or quantity invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: ifms_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance about iFMS fertilizer subsidy services. Categories: 'transaction_failed', 'subsidy_not_applied', 'retailer_issue', 'stock_unavailable', 'quantity_limit_exceeded'. Must check transaction or subsidy status first. Requires session_token. Does NOT resolve grievance. Fails if category invalid or duplicate.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: ifms_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks an iFMS grievance. Returns resolution status and remarks. Requires session_token. Does NOT raise new grievances. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
